description: Use this when the user wants to see what is available rather than search for one specific mandate — the shape of the market, how many companies are qualified, or which sectors and geographies are represented. Returns Cape Partners' broader scored deal universe as aggregate counts by sector, with size bands and the best fit achieved in each: no company names and no individual records. Prefer a mandate-specific search when the user has one in mind.

focus.description: What the user wants an overview of, in their own words.

geography.description: Country or region the user named, if any.

limit.description: Maximum sector rows to return. Default 20.

sector.description: Sector or sub-sector the user named, if any.

name: get_deal_flow
